new_value: Decision: keep the flatfile architecture with the shipped mitigations (a158b0ffd7: pre-commit hook blocking worker-side store staging + per-branch checkpoints in sync/janitor). Rationale: all 3 measured incidents were the git-rewind mechanism, which the mitigations close; bd flatfile (v1.1.0-flatfile.2, brew) has internal file locking for process-level RMW; option (b) per-worker stores breaks global claim semantics (bd ready/claim need the shared pool); option (c) dolt backend is a non-standard build for this fleet and dolt already proved unstable here (Attic panic in dolt-server.log). Investigated the 'dolt keeps restarting' suspicion: NOBODY restarts it — the running dolt sql-server (PID 1048711, 27 days old, port 36815, zero clients) belongs to another heft user (langwei), and our .beads/dolt-server.pid/port files are stale debris git-synced from the macOS Attic store (claims dead pid 42946/port 53901; bd flatfile provably never touches them). Revisit (c) only if a NEW loss incident appears post-hook that is not the rewind mechanism — recheck after a week of fleet runtime.
